{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
data['revenue_numeric'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA rows: revenue == 999999.99
qa_rows = data[data['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]

# Check if any QA rows have converted=1
qa_converted = qa_rows['converted'].sum()

print("Number of QA rows:", len(qa_rows))
print("Sum of converted in QA rows:", qa_converted)
print("\nFirst few rows of QA rows:")
print(qa_rows[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'status', 'revenue', 'converted']].head())"}
